'''6174 (six thousand, one hundred [and] seventy-four)''' is the [[natural number]] following 6173 and preceding 6175.

==Properties==
* It is a [[Kaprekar's routine#Families of Kaprekar’s constants|Kaprekar's Constant]].<ref>{{cite arXiv |last=Hanover |first=Daniel |title=The Base Dependent Behavior of Kaprekar's Routine: A Theoretical and Computational Study Revealing New Regularities |date=2017-10-16 |class=math.GM |eprint=1710.06308}}</ref>
